metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins by cbrandborg

plugins.name: xmind-campaign
plugins.description: Convert XMind mind maps into structured Obsidian vaults for DnD campaigns. Handles full pipeline: extraction, classification, scene generation, completeness auditing, and Canvas creation.

plugins.name: voting-assistant
plugins.description: Algocratic voting decision-support pipeline for Danish elections. Combines quantitative party analysis with qualitative voter interview to produce personalized voting recommendations.

plugins.name: gemini-images
plugins.description: Generate and modify images using Google Gemini's image generation API. Includes prompt refinement, style guide support, iterative workflows, and cost controls.
